name: oxo-flow-chipseq
title: ChIP-seq: peak calling, QC and differential analysis
excluded: UMITOOLS_EXTRACT / umi_extract — with_umi is hardcoded to false in chipseq.nf (dead branch at 2.1.0; the parameter does not exist in nextflow.config)

prepare_genome / samplesheet_check — Nextflow plumbing (compressed-reference gunzip/untar, custom getchromsizes, from-scratch BWA/Bowtie2/Chromap index builders, samplesheet validation/staging); the port consumes pre-built plain files. GTF2BED and GENOME_BLACKLIST_REGIONS are ported as gated rules (make_gene_bed / make_blacklist_regions)
multi-antibody consensus grouping (consensus_cluster) — upstream groupTuple(by: antibody) needs a per-sample antibody attribute; the port assumes a single antibody (config.antibody)
save_align_intermeds / save_mapped / save_tracks publish branches — save_macs_pileup is ported (conditional pileup .bdg publication in both macs3 rules)
multiqc pipeline summary / software versions sections — nf-core template paramsSummaryMap/softwareVersionsToYAML from Nextflow metadata; multiqc_data / multiqc_plots directory publication is ported

multi-library MergeSamFiles branch — upstream groups libraries by meta.id minus _T\d+ and merges variable-size file sets, which expand_inputs cannot express; single-library default path only (upstream symlink shortcut for single-library samples, replicated exactly)
bowtie2 / chromap aligner alternatives — aligner=bwa is the default; STAR is ported as a gated branch (aligner='star')
DUMP_SOFTWARE_VERSIONS — Nextflow plumbing (oxo-flow has no nf-core pipelines version dump)
description: ChIP-seq peak calling, QC and differential analysis for paired-end reads: FastQC and Trim Galore read QC, BWA-MEM (default) or STAR alignment, library merge and Picard mark-duplicates, BAMTools filtering against a blacklist with orphan-read removal, preseq and phantompeakqualtools library complexity QC, bigWig tracks and deepTools QC plots, MACS3 peak calling with input controls in broad (default) or narrow mode, HOMER peak annotation, FRiP scoring, consensus peaks across replicates (MACS3 merge, featureCounts quantification, DESeq2 QC), an IGV session and a MultiQC report. Optional gated rules derive the gene-body BED from the GTF (GTF2BED), the blacklist-complement regions file and a STAR index.

requirements: genome FASTA and FASTA index (fasta, fai)
gene-body regions BED, derived upstream via GTF2BED (gene_bed)
BWA index directory for the reference FASTA (bwa_index: *.amb, *.ann, *.bwt, *.pac, *.sa); for aligner='star' a STAR index directory (star_index, or build one with make_star_index=true)
raw paired-end FASTQ reads named raw/{pair_id}_R{1,2}.fastq.gz with sample metadata in [[pairs]] and ip_ids
compute: up to 12 CPUs / 72 GB per rule (bwa_mem, star_align, trimgalore, star_genomegenerate); most rules request 6 CPUs / 36 GB
disk: several GB of pinned container images pulled by Docker/Singularity
